operators.name: max_pool2d

parameters.name: input
parameters.shape: same as pooled input [N, C, H, W]

returns.shape: same as reference output [N, C, outH, outW] computed from pooling formula

semantics: Executes 2D max pooling over the input tensor using exactly the specified kernel_size, stride, padding, dilation, and ceil_mode
For each output element, takes the maximum over the corresponding pooling window; if return_indices were true the indices would be returned, but here return_indices is fixed to False
Output spatial size follows PyTorch MaxPool2d formula with dilation, padding, stride, and ceil_mode
The reference model moves input from CPU to CUDA before computation; the operator expects a CUDA input tensor
No bias is added; only max pooling is performed
Apply 2D max pooling with kernel_size=(2,2), stride=2, padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False
Input tensor is moved from CPU to CUDA device by the validation harness before forward
Output has shape [16,3,2048,1024] and dtype float32 on CUDA
Return the pooled output tensor as the final result
